threat_event: Ransomware operator uses a stolen cloud administrator session to encrypt platform databases and delete backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing administrator rights; backups in the production account and not immutable; no after-hours security monitoring
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 CP-9; IR-6); Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate)
existing_controls: MFA with hardware keys for administrators; point-in-time recovery
treatment_plan: Immutable backups in a separate account and second U.S. region; just-in-time admin access; managed 24x7 detection; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Theft of FTI and CJI during an intrusion, followed by extortion (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unrestricted outbound traffic from containers; 90-day logs; no egress alerting
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8.2); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
existing_controls: Web application firewall; encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Egress allow-list; alerting on large transfers; 7-year log archive

threat_event: Unscreened engineer with administrator access misuses or discloses CJI or FTI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 cloud engineers hold standing access to all tenants without fingerprint checks, Security Addendum certification, or Pub. 1075 investigation
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 PS-3; Appendix H); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 2.C.3)
existing_controls: Commercial background check at hire; audit logging
treatment_plan: Remove regulated-tenant access until screening is complete; screening gate in onboarding

threat_event: Agency or IRS Safeguards review finds staff with CJI or FTI access who are not screened, leading to suspended access or contract termination
threat_source: Customer agency or IRS Office of Safeguards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 unscreened staff with CJI access; 2 with FTI access; out-of-date authorized list
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(2)); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 PS-3)
treatment_plan: Same as R-003, plus monthly authorized-list update to AC-01

threat_event: FTI and CJI in support ticket screenshots are disclosed to a ticketing vendor that is not an approved subcontractor
threat_source: Workforce and agency users (error); service provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule against regulated data in tickets; vendor not approved by the IRS and has no CJIS Security Addendum
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(8)); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9)
treatment_plan: Block attachments from AC-01 and AC-02 tenants; purge existing attachments with vendor certification; in-platform secure support channel; tell the agencies

threat_event: The 2025 staging copy of AC-01 data is treated as an unreported FTI spillage
threat_source: IRS Office of Safeguards via AC-01
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No Data Testing Request; no deletion record; no control against repeat
treatment_plan: Disclose to the AC-01 disclosure officer; block production data in non-production

threat_event: Backups cannot be restored within the 8-hour contract recovery time after data corruption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restore never tested end to end; no contingency plan; document storage not backed up separately
treatment_plan: Contingency plan; quarterly restore tests with timing

threat_event: Loss of the cloud region stops the platform longer than the contract recovery time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single-region design
treatment_plan: Scripted rebuild in a second U.S. region

threat_event: An incident cannot be scoped because logs have rolled off, forcing broad notification
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 90-day retention; logs deletable by administrators
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 AU-11); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 AU-11)
treatment_plan: 7-year write-once archive in a separate account

threat_event: CJIS audit finds CJI transmitted with modules that are not FIPS 140-3 certified after 2026-09-21
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ingress and gateway libraries not in validated mode; no module inventory
treatment_plan: FIPS 140-3 certified modules on CJI paths; module inventory

threat_event: Attacker uses the AC-02 interface API key exposed in a pipeline variable to query or inject records through the sheriff's message switch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key in plain text, visible to 20 engineers, never rotated (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Rotate key now; move to secrets manager; mutual TLS for the interface

threat_event: Compromised build pipeline or open-source dependency inserts malicious code into the platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Images not signed; no provenance checks
existing_controls: Pinned dependencies; dependency scanning; two-person code review
treatment_plan: Sign images and verify at deployment; pipeline hardening

threat_event: Application authorization flaw lets one agency's user see another agency's records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared database with row-level tenant filter for AC-02 and municipal tenants
existing_controls: Tenant filter in every query; 2025 penetration test passed isolation tests
treatment_plan: Automated cross-tenant tests in the pipeline; dynamic scanning

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over municipal local accounts without MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for local accounts in 4 tenants
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA on local accounts

threat_event: Phishing leads to compromise of a staff mailbox holding agency data from implementations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agency data received in email; no secure transfer tool
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; spam filtering; annual training
treatment_plan: Secure transfer tool for implementations; mailbox retention rule for agency data

threat_event: Known vulnerability in a running container is exploited before it is patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No runtime or authenticated scanning; no patch deadlines; 2 open penetration test findings
treatment_plan: Weekly authenticated scanning; patch deadlines by severity

threat_event: Support staff browse agency records without a work reason
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Support can read every tenant; access logs not reviewed
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 AU-6); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 AC-6)
treatment_plan: Ticket-linked, time-limited tenant access for support; weekly access log review

threat_event: Caseworkers adopt a wrong AI eligibility recommendation, causing wrongful denials or overpayments
threat_source: AI model error with automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented human-review rule; about 90% acceptance rate; no accuracy monitoring
existing_controls: Caseworker makes the final entry in the agency eligibility system
treatment_plan: Human-review rule, reason codes, accuracy sampling (P10)

threat_event: The AI assistant produces less accurate recommendations for some groups of applicants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No bias testing before the pilot
treatment_plan: Bias testing plan and thresholds (P10); pause expansion until met

threat_event: Applicant data sent to the managed model service is retained or used for training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model service added without vendor review or data-use terms confirmed
existing_controls: Provider standard terms state no training on customer prompts
treatment_plan: Vendor review; confirm FedRAMP scope and data-use terms in writing

threat_event: The company tells an agency too late to meet its CJIS, IRS, or Florida reporting clock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No internal 1-hour rule; plan lacks agency clocks; no tested contact list
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8.4); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
treatment_plan: P08 runbook and matrix; tabletop with AC-01 and AC-02

threat_event: Data of a former municipal customer is breached or disclosed after the contract ended
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Data kept after contract end; no deletion process
treatment_plan: Delete the data with certificate; contract-end procedure

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes cached agency data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to agency sites
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: encryption reduces risk to Low

threat_event: Recovery stalls because only the Cloud Operations Lead knows how to rebuild the platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Undocumented recovery steps
treatment_plan: Written recovery procedures; cross-train 2 engineers

threat_event: An emergency console change breaks production or exposes storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Console write access outside the pipeline; no emergency change record
treatment_plan: Emergency change procedure; console write access by break-glass only

threat_event: Object storage holding agency documents is made public by mistake
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Storage settings managed partly in the console
existing_controls: Organization policy blocks public buckets; weekly posture scan
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: existing guardrails keep likelihood Low; tracked in weekly posture scans

threat_event: A hurricane closes the headquarters and disrupts support and operations staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Most staff in one Florida area
existing_controls: Platform is cloud-hosted; staff can work remotely; remote staff in Georgia and Alabama
treatment_plan: Accepted: remote work covers the loss of the office

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack blocks agency users during a tax deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public sign-in page
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; web application firewall rate limits
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Identity provider outage locks administrators out during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No break-glass administrator accounts
treatment_plan: Two sealed break-glass accounts with hardware keys, tested quarterly

threat_event: AC-03 caseworkers paste IRS income data into case notes, putting FTI in a tenant where it is prohibited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No detection of FTI patterns in AC-03 notes
existing_controls: Contract forbids FTI; AC-03 trains its staff
treatment_plan: Pattern alert for IRS income data in AC-03 notes; reminder banner

threat_event: AC-01 does not renew in 2027 because no independent assurance report is available
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 report or GovRAMP verification
treatment_plan: SOC 2 Type 1 by 2027-03; Type 2 period to follow (P09)

threat_event: Agency data received during implementations is kept on shared drives after go-live
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No deletion step at implementation close
existing_controls: Shared drives restricted to project teams
treatment_plan: Deletion step in the implementation close checklist
